title: Football and beauty: L'Oréal enters the Paris Saint-Germain sponsorship arena
summary: French cosmetics giant L'Oréal has become a sponsor of Paris Saint-Germain (PSG) through 2028, in a partnership aimed at promoting “a contemporary vision of French excellence around the world,” the football club announced on Thursday, October 8.
